trace_checks: Exactly 78 adapted ticks per trial, followed by exact ordinary targets; deterministic saved-target replay matched state and ball trajectories.
findings: Seven trials improve closest distance; seeds 6,7,8 worsen.
Seeds 0,1,2,3,4,5,9 reach closest points at ticks 82–91, shortly after handoff at tick 78. Handoff is an unresolved confound.
Closest tool-to-ball offsets are predominantly along negative task y; policy gripper targets at closest points are 48–67 percent in those seven trials.
A gripper/ball contact was observed at seed 1 tick 90, without a hold. Contact audit samples at policy ticks and can miss between-tick collisions, including the event leading to seed 5 escaping.
next: Investigate fixed-window handoff and terminal alignment before another ACT retrain. Do not infer task success or change benchmark phase definitions from this diagnostic.
